# Observability Spec v0.1

## Queue
ready, leased, running, blocked, oldest age, P0/P1 backlog

## Quality
blind addition, precision action, residual, E3/E4, frontier escalation, defer

## Operations
success/failure, retries, lease expiry, throttle, duration, context resets

## Economics
RCU by estate/capability, RCU per accepted semantic unit, frontier share

## Independence
I0/I1/I2/I3 distribution, blindness breaches
